# Every Ballot Counts
> Independent research on federal election-data systems, contracts and data flows ahead of the Nov 3, 2026 US midterms. Built from public records; claims carry evidence marks (D primary, R reporting, I inference, U unresolved, K verify). Not an investigation with inside sources; no vendor wrongdoing is alleged.

- [System Registry](https://good-luck-with-that-ops.github.io/Every_Ballot_Counts/registry/): one entry per system, vehicle or data feed
- [Phrase Trail](https://good-luck-with-that-ops.github.io/Every_Ballot_Counts/phrase-trail/): recurring language across statutes, procurement and reports
- [Architecture map](https://good-luck-with-that-ops.github.io/Every_Ballot_Counts/map/architecture.html)
- [About and method](https://good-luck-with-that-ops.github.io/Every_Ballot_Counts/about.html)
